name: coss-sv
description: Unofficial high-fidelity Svelte 5 port of the COSS UI component library.
author: Miel

scripts.ci: pnpm verify && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm --filter @coss-sv/ui pack:check && pnpm --filter @coss-sv/docs registry:smoke && pnpm test:docs:e2e
scripts.format:biome: biome format --write --vcs-root=. .github apps docs packages scripts skills tests .coderabbit.yaml AGENTS.md CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md CONTRIBUTING.md NOTICE.md README.md SECURITY.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md biome.json package.json playwright.config.ts pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json vitest.workspace.ts
scripts.format:biome:check: biome format --vcs-root=. .github apps docs packages scripts skills tests .coderabbit.yaml AGENTS.md CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md CONTRIBUTING.md NOTICE.md README.md SECURITY.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md biome.json package.json playwright.config.ts pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json vitest.workspace.ts
scripts.lint: biome lint --vcs-root=. .github apps docs packages scripts skills tests .coderabbit.yaml AGENTS.md CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md CONTRIBUTING.md NOTICE.md README.md SECURITY.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md biome.json package.json playwright.config.ts pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json vitest.workspace.ts
scripts.test: pnpm test:repo && turbo run build && pnpm test:harness && turbo run test:unit --concurrency=1
scripts.verify: pnpm test:repo && pnpm parity:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm check && pnpm registry:check
